text: The Climate and Disaster Resilience Enhancement Program (CDREP), Subprogram 1, is a policy-based lending initiative by the Asian Development Bank aimed at enhancing Pakistan's institutional, financial, and planning frameworks for climate and disaster resilience. It is the first of two subprograms, focusing on foundational policy and institutional reforms to catalyze investment and financing instruments, with a future Contingent Disaster Financing option to provide rapid budget support post-disaster.
